finding.description: frankenstein2_agent_hook_identity_v1 required exactly one HANDOFF marker on prompt line 1, while frankenstein2_agent_workexecution_adapter_v21 independently accepted a matching HANDOFF line anywhere in the prompt with broader whitespace. The same observed Agent PreToolUse payload could therefore be rejected by the identity parser but persisted by the WorkExecution adapter.

Existing parallel adapter test was converted to directly executable stdlib unittest and extended with displaced-marker fail-closed regression plus identity/atomicity checks.
GRID10 Cognitive Envelope CI path filter and deterministic test step now include test_frankenstein2_agent_workexecution_adapter_v21.py.
